concerns.text: T036 attempts to verify `data/processed/merged_data.csv` before any task actually produces that file (production occurs in US1 task T013). This violates the producer‑before‑consumer rule; foundational verification must be moved after the merge task.

T037 validates `data/processed/analysis_results.csv` prior to any task generating that artifact (generation occurs in US2 tasks T020‑T023). The verification should be placed after the final analysis task (e.g., T024).

All US2 tasks (e.g., T020, T021, T022, T023) depend on the unified dataset created in US1 (T015/T016). This creates a cross‑story dependency, breaking the requirement that each user‑story block be independently implementable and testable.
US3 tasks (T026‑T029, T054) rely on `analysis_results.csv` produced in US2, again violating the independent shippable unit principle for user‑story groups.
